sessionName: Sunday session — test fixture subset (2 of the real 10 ops)

ops.title: Trays in — chicken, chickpeas, peppers
ops.body: Chicken breast (600 g), chickpeas (250 g drained), frozen sliced peppers (160 g) and red onion (70 g) onto two trays. Oven 200°C fan, 25 minutes.

ops.title: Shred for two slaws — corrected per D0-014
ops.body: 515 g red cabbage and 230 g carrot, shredded fine — Thursday's burger slaw, Friday's wrap AND Friday's salmon slaw all come out of this (the Phase 0 op text undercounted at 335 g by omitting the Friday-dinner salmon slaw; D0-014 corrects it here).

yields.note: Cooks 600 g; the three consuming lunches plate 575 g combined (D0-020) — ~25 g headroom for tasting/loss, stated explicitly rather than silently tightened.
